purpose: Редактор отчетов с генерацией LaTeX, локальной сборкой PDF, 2D/3D-графиками и CAD-подобными TikZ-фигурами.

features.graph2D: line and bar charts through PGFPlots
features.graph3D: numeric X;Y;Z series through PGFPlots addplot3
features.cadFigures: dimensioned box, cylinder, cone and sphere through TikZ

blockTypes.filenameRule: Use a path relative to the images/ folder.

blockTypes.dataFormat: One row per line, semicolon-separated cells.

blockTypes.dimensionRules: For box use width/depth/height as X/Y/Z. For cylinder and cone use diameter/height. For sphere use diameter.

graph3DGuidance: 3D points must be one point per line in X;Y;Z format and all coordinates must be numeric.
cadGuidance: Use type=cad for volumetric figures, signed dimensions and simple CAD-like sketches.
Use shape=box for rectangular solids, cylinder for shafts/tubes, cone for conical parts and sphere for balls.
Keep dimensions as strings to preserve user formatting and units.
